text:
maria: Kicking off a config-only rollout in the 12:30 UTC change window. Small QOS + routing-floor + timeout adjustments. Keeping it staged, no model changes. Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/config-2026-03-12

kevin: Thx — what's the canary progression?

maria: Canary: 0% -> 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100%, 10m watch at each step. If anything looks off we stop and rollback.

anika: Ops checklist? metrics to watch?

maria: p95 latency, error-rate, queue length, tokens/sec, and per-route success ratio. Watch cost-per-token for embedded routes (just in case batching regresses).

luis: Rollback triggers I care about: error-rate +3% absolute sustained for 5m, p95 > 800ms for 10m, or sudden queue length growth >2x. Also abort if any OOMs in the dedicated pool.

sam: Also add routing misroute check — if fallback rate to smaller model >1% for more than 5m, abort.

maria: Added. Also we're enabling the new routing-floor (min_weight=0.05) for latency-sensitive lanes; tinybatch window reduced to 12ms for those lanes.

kevin: Any pinning needed? I want the latency-sensitive route pinned to model v2.1.3-quant so fallback doesn't flip.

maria: Good call. Pinning: route=A-sp-latency -> model:v2.1.3-quant. Others keep floating.

deploy-bot: [deploy queued] config-change cfg-2026-03-12T12:30, author=maria, type=config-only, canary=staged. Run command: /deploy config cfg-2026-03-12T12:30

anika: Release notes? short blurb for release channel pls.

maria: I wrote a short note: "Config-only: adjust routing floor and reduce tinybatch window for latency-sensitive routes; add safety fence and new rollback triggers." Will paste after first canary step completes.

ops-bot: Monitoring groups notified: infra/observability, serving/runtime, sla-watch. Alert thresholds auto-applied for this rollout.

deploy-bot: Canary step 1 -> 10% started at 2815010000. Observing metrics for 10m.

kevin: Watching p95 now. No change at 2m.

luis: backend mem looks stable. No OOM logs.

maria: At 10m, if all green we push to 30%. Otherwise, hold and diag.

deploy-bot: Canary step 1 -> success. Progressing to 30% at 2815010300.

sam: Quick note: make sure we don't accidentally enable the new batch-cache in the same change. Confirmed?

maria: Confirmed — batch-cache flag remains off. This is strictly routing + tinybatch + pin.

deploy-bot: Canary step 2 -> 30% completed at 2815010450. Moving to 60% now.

kevin: p95 +5ms, error-rate unchanged. Good.

maria: If everyone OK I'll post release note to #announcements after 100% complete.

deploy-bot: Rollout 100% completed at 2815010600. No automatic rollbacks triggered.

anika: Nice. I'll draft the public-facing note.

luis: Filing a post-check: run the cost-per-token job overnight and confirm no regressions.

maria: Added a followup task in the change ticket. Thanks all — closing this thread once release note is posted. :tada:
